candidate.name: Strategist
candidate.architecture: Fixed ReLU trajectory features from the original six inputs; learned 8→128→128→64→1 Tanh target head; fixed linear paddle feedback emits up/stay/down scores.
candidate.selection_note: Selected before final testing. Of three candidates compared on the same 128 fresh development seeds, this export had the highest weaker-target score, no rally losses to either target, and the highest paired match win rate against the attacker (111/128). All final seeds were untouched.
candidate.design_note: Frozen, hand-designed trajectory features and fixed paddle feedback are embedded alongside the PyTorch-trained target head. This is a hybrid model, not a network that discovered all geometry from raw inputs.

verification_note: The exported candidate and v2 were evaluated through native ONNX Runtime in all final blocks. PyTorch/native ONNX actions agree on 8,192 reachable observations. Six complete matches reproduce in the live TypeScript engine and browser WASM: 26,838 decisions, 13,443 frames, 16 loop draws and 3 timeouts, with 100% action agreement. Fixed engine, training contract, v2 weights and attacker hashes remain unchanged.
